conn.description: Connect an APM or observability backend. PatchMan reads its view of who calls whom (and how much) to draw the live service map. Everything is read-only.

providerHelp.coroot: Coroot's application map plus its eBPF metrics: requests/s, errors and latency per call, without changing your apps.
providerHelp.prometheus: Any Prometheus-compatible API (Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Thanos, Mimir). PatchMan recognises coroot-node-agent, Istio, Linkerd, OpenTelemetry / Tempo service graph and Cilium Hubble metrics.
providerHelp.jaeger: Jaeger's dependency graph: who calls whom and how often (no errors or latency).
providerHelp.kiali: Kiali's Istio traffic graph: requests/s, error rate and response time per call.
providerHelp.signoz: SigNoz's service dependency graph: call rate, error rate and latency per call.
providerHelp.datadog: Datadog APM service dependencies for one env (which service calls which; Datadog's API gives no per-call rates).

conn.name: Name

coroot.bearer: Recommended: an API key of a Viewer service account (crt_…). Create one in Coroot under Settings → Users.
coroot.login: A Coroot user's email and password; PatchMan signs in and renews the session.
coroot.session: For SSO users: paste the coroot_session cookie from your browser. It lasts 7 days.
coroot.apikey: A project API key only unlocks metrics: no map from Coroot and no health. Note: it is also the key agents send data with.

datadog.bearer: Datadog: API + application key, or a personal / service access token.

authHelpGeneric.none: The API is open (or behind your network).
authHelpGeneric.apikey: Sent in the provider's API key header (change it under Advanced).
authHelpGeneric.session: A session cookie pasted from your browser.
authHelpGeneric.login: PatchMan signs in and keeps the session.

conn.sessionHelp: The value of the coroot_session cookie (from the browser's developer tools).

scopeHelp.project: The Coroot project the map opens with. A new connection lists its projects after Test.
scopeHelp.env: The Datadog env to map, e.g. prod.
scopeHelp.namespaces: Comma-separated; empty = every namespace Kiali shows (up to 20).

conn.corootProjectKeyHelp: Lets PatchMan query Coroot's metrics directly for per-call errors and latency. Without it they come through Coroot's dashboards API, which also works.
conn.backendLocalDesc: Reaches backends on your VPN / local network.
conn.backendRemoteDesc: Shared with your team; reaches what the server can.
conn.backendNoteSession: A session cookie lives on one backend, so it is saved only there.
conn.headerNameHelp: Leave empty for the provider's default.
conn.insecureHelp: Only for self-signed certificates you trust.
conn.datadogNote: Use your site's API host as the URL, e.g. https://api.datadoghq.eu for EU.

notes.metrics_only: metrics only (no map or health from Coroot)
notes.rates_only: call rates only — no errors or latency
notes.env_required: set the env to draw a map
notes.secrets_skipped: {{value}} Secret references not read (enable "Read hosts from Secrets" on the connection)
notes.prometheus_not_found: no Prometheus found in the cluster

share.title: Share {{name}}
share.description: People and teams you add can draw service maps through this connection. The credentials never leave PatchMan.
share.identityWarning: They will read the backend as the signed-in user of this connection.

sidebar.deleteDescription: The connection and its shares are removed. Open maps that use it stop updating.

sources.clusterPromHelp: Also read traffic metrics from the cluster's own Prometheus (Istio, Linkerd, Hubble, OpenTelemetry).

toolbar.groupHint: Fold each namespace into one node (automatic above {{count}} nodes). Double-click a namespace to open it.
toolbar.searchHint: Enter: focus on the first match

hud.grouped: {{count}} namespaces folded — double-click one to open it

empty.title: Draw a live service map
empty.text: Pick a Kubernetes connection and/or an observability connection (Coroot, Prometheus, Jaeger, Kiali, SigNoz, Datadog).

loading.title: Building the map…
loading.text: Reading workloads, configuration and traffic from every source.

error.title: The map could not be built

emptyGraph.title: Nothing to draw
emptyGraph.text: No services matched. Check the sources' notes above, or loosen the filters.

detail.title: Details
detail.declaredOnly: Declared in configuration — no traffic observed for it.
detail.evidenceNote: Only key names and the extracted host:port are shown — never values.
detail.colErrorsHint: Share of calls that failed: 5xx, failed or a gRPC error (4xx is not counted)
detail.responsesNote: Requests/s per status as the source reports it. Only 5xx, failed and gRPC errors count as errors.
detail.errRpsHint: Failed requests per second on this call
detail.hiddenByFilters: Hidden by the filters or namespace selection — still counted in the totals

export.failed: Could not add the map to a whiteboard
export.capped: The whiteboard got the first {{count}} nodes.

ns.contextHint: What the chosen namespaces call, or are called by, elsewhere stays on the map, faded.

status.unknown: Not recognised by the agent — not counted as an error
status.failed: Failed: connection error, timeout or an error reply
status.4xx: Client error — not counted as an error
